Vgl. [01 \- 10X \> Week 1: Exercises, Soreness, AMRAP, Measurements, Capacity Test](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MpU4bNbV70wqvNwi88wIp2dMALjtVWInb_sqT8uSmB8/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.q6fq1jg4ewt0)

→ oder mit beiden Armen?
